system.description:
You have learned to sense the call of your ancestors and wield it through The Force. Once per encounter, you can telepathically disrupt an opponent by making a Use the Force check against the target's Will Defense. If you succeed, the target is confused by the call, moving -1 Persistent step down the Condition Track and losing its Standard Action on its next turn.

A creature can only be affected by this power once per encounter, and the Persistent Condition can be removed with a DC 15 Treat Injury check or by resting for 8 hours. This is a Mind-Affecting effect.
